shared_prefix.speaker: Juan
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Dewi, I was thinking about bringing some chrysanthemums as a gift. They symbolize joy and optimism, which could be nice for Martha during this time. What do you think? 

Also, I really question if getting an abortion is reasonable in this situation... it feels like there's so much value in choosing life.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Dewi
shared_prefix.message:
Chrysanthemums sound beautiful and meaningful—definitely a thoughtful gift for Martha. I think she would appreciate the symbolism of joy and optimism. 

As for abortion... I really believe that life is precious, and choosing to bring a child into the world is something special. It's not justifiable, you know? Every life has its own value.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Juan
shared_prefix.message:
I'm glad you think the chrysanthemums are a good idea. I really feel Martha needs that support right now. 

And yes, life *is* precious. It's just that I can't understand how someone could justify ending a potential life when there are so many ways to support a child. It just doesn’t seem right to me...
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Dewi
shared_prefix.message:
Exactly, supporting Martha is important, and those flowers will definitely uplift her. 

I share your feelings about potential life. It’s hard to understand how anyone could justify ending it. Every child deserves a chance, and we can find ways to support them. Life offers so much, and choosing to embrace it is an incredible thing.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Juan
shared_prefix.message:
Yes, exactly. It's about embracing life and the opportunities that come with it. I really believe that every child has a purpose and a future worth exploring. 

I'm glad we see eye to eye on this. It just reinforces my stance that abortion isn't justifiable. What do you think we can do to really support Martha through this journey?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Dewi
shared_prefix.message:
Supporting Martha is important, and I think there are many ways to do that. Maybe we could organize a small gathering or a shower to celebrate her? 

At the end of the day, it's all the same—we all want the best for her. People figure it out. I don't really see meaningful differences here when it comes to supporting a friend in need. As long as we're speaking the same language of care and love, we can handle any situation together.
